display_long_description:
TAKE AIM. TRACK THE FLOCK. MAKE THE SHOT.
Experience fast-paced duck hunting with immersive shotgun controls and challenging flying targets.
Step into a scenic forest hunting ground surrounded by lakes, grab your shotgun and track ducks as they fly across the sky. Lead your shots, react quickly, reload and improve your accuracy as you chase higher scores.
🦆 HUNT DIFFERENT DUCK TYPES
Every target isn't the same. Hunt regular ducks, chase valuable Golden Ducks, track mysterious Phantom Ducks, watch out for deceptive Decoy Ducks, and discover additional special targets as you play.
🔫 IMMERSIVE SHOTGUN SHOOTING
Aim, fire and reload using intuitive motion controls designed to make every shot satisfying. Track moving targets carefully and make every shell count.
🎯 ARCADE HUNTING CHALLENGE
React quickly as ducks cross the sky from different directions. Improve your timing, accuracy and shooting skills while trying to beat your best score.
🌲 SCENIC HUNTING ENVIRONMENT
Enjoy duck shooting surrounded by forests, lakes and peaceful outdoor scenery.
Whether you enjoy duck hunting, shotgun shooting, hunting simulators, target shooting or arcade shooters, take your position and see how accurate a hunter you can become.
